svg.title: P2A Fastener faults - Ayas coupon template (1:1)
svg.text: P2A Fastener faults
role: train | plate 100 x 100 x 3 mm | drill Ø4.1 for Ø4 fasteners | Ayas aircraft-representative coupon (commercial alloy)

g.title: D1 crack.slit: jeweller's saw 1 mm; crack-like notch; hidden under the 8 mm rivet head (realistic)
D2 crack.slit: jeweller's saw 2 mm; crack-like notch; only its tip reaches the head edge
D3 crack.slit: jeweller's saw 4 mm; crack-like notch along the rivet row
D4 crack.slit: jeweller's saw 6 mm; crack-like notch
D5 corrosion.fretting: graphite smear 8 x 2; SIMULATED smoking-rivet streak (graphite/oxide smear), not real fretting

g.text: Print at 100 % (actual size, no 'fit to page').
Check: this bar must measure 50.0 mm.

svg.text: Datum corner A = top-left of face A: punch a small 'A' at the marked spot. Coordinates in mm from A: u
right, v down.
Make:
1. Punch the datum "A" (top-left of face A) if not done; photograph faces A and B bare.
2. Tape the P2A template on face A; light centre-punch the 10 hole crosshairs H1-H10.
3. Drill 2.5 mm pilots at all 10 marks from face A.
4. Drill 4.1 mm from face A at H1, H2, H4, H5, H7, H8, H9, H10; deburr both sides of these 8 holes.
5. Turn the plate over and drill H3 and H6 at 4.1 mm from face B, so the exit burr is on face A. Do NOT
deburr face A of H3 and H6 (burrs X1, X2).
6. File H6 oval with a round needle file along the row (u), about 0.5 mm each side, to 5.1 x 4.1 mm
(caliper inside jaws).
7. Jeweller's saw slits, blade threaded through the hole, cut outwards along the drawn line, length from
the hole edge: D1 1 mm from H1 down, D2 2 mm from H2 down, D3 4 mm from H4 to the right, D4 6 mm from
H5 up.
8. Set 8 blind rivets at H1, H2, H4, H5, H7, H8, H9, H10 (heads on face A). Leave H3 and H6 open.
9. Fretting streak D5 (simulated) - rub soft pencil graphite (6B) with a trace of oil on a cotton bud, lay
one 8 x 2 mm streak from the R7 head edge upwards (-v), smudge it once in that direction with a gloved
finger.
10. Wipe the rest of the face with isopropyl alcohol (not the streak); photograph; measure (guide section
Designed findings:
missing_fastener H3, elongated_hole H6, pitch H8-H9, edge_distance H10, crack_indication D3,
crack_indication D4, corrosion D5, hold_unknown X1, hold_unknown X2
